description.en: Aoi and Keita, who attend the same high school, live next door to each other and have been childhood friends ever since Keita moved in when they were in middle school. Even though they're just friends who always goof around together, Aoi suddenly notices that Keita has been looking cool lately...
description.vi:
"M-mình muốn hôn cậu ấy quá đi~ Nhưng hai đứa mình chỉ là bạn..."

Aoi là bạn nối khố với Keita, cả hai thân nhau đến mức có thể nói là trên tình bạn dưới tình yêu. Nhưng Aoi lại dần có những cảm xúc đặc biệt hơn với cậu bạn thân của mình, cô nàng muốn làm đủ thứ chuyện "tình củm" với anh chàng lắm, nhưng vì hai chữ "bạn thân" mà nàng chần chừ mãi. Nhưng Aoi không biết là Keita đang giả ngủ trên bàn kia cũng đang chờ đợi cái gì đó, và cậu quyết định đẩy láo.

カバーイラスト：おの秋人

+++**第1巻の内容：**
1. 『悪役令嬢に仕立て上げられた私は、魔王と一緒にスローライフを送ることにします』　漫画：ななしののん　[原作](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n2986fc/)：チェレステ
勇者の婚約者と間違われて誘拐された！すみません、既に婚約破棄されておりますが？

婚約破棄の末、処刑されたと思ったら、幼少期に戻っていて――!?

前世の記憶を思い出した悪役令嬢の私――。…いやいや、修道女エンド目前なんですが⁉

第一王子から婚約破棄されて、次に宛がわれたのは変わり者の伯爵で――!?
+++
+++**第2巻の内容：**
1. 『行き遅れ令嬢はおひとり様を満喫したい』　漫画：アズマミドリ　[原作](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n8771gh/)：栗栖
初恋の元婚約相手なんて、さっさと忘れてバリバリに働いてやるんだから! 
2. 『屈辱的な婚約破棄をされたら大嫌いな幼馴染が求婚してきたけど思い通りにはさせません! 』　漫画：白木　[原作](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n4633hh/)：葵れん
辺境に嫁がされそうになっていたところを、絶縁状態の幼馴染に救われて…?
3. 『一人ぼっち令嬢と一匹狼さん』　漫画：宇海みづ
悪い魔女と特徴が似ているからと、一方的に狼が棲む森へ追いやられ――。

教育に長けている魔族を召喚するつもりが、現れたのは予想外の上級悪魔――!?

1. 『婚約破棄共同戦線』　漫画：風見まつり　キャラクター原案：おの秋人
学生時代、自由を得るため協力し、婚約破棄を成功させた令嬢と騎士は再会し——？
2. 『精霊術士は婚約破棄されても幸せを掴む』　漫画：あぜか流渡　[原作](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n6837hr/)：かなしつしつげ
精霊と会話できる令嬢は婚約破棄された後、王都から追放されてしまい——
3. 『毒が見えるので密かに皇子を守っていたら、意地汚い女だと婚約破棄されました。後から側にいてほしいと言われても、もう遅いです。』　漫画：朝谷コトリ　[原作](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n3166hq/)：香月深亜
毒から皇子を守っていたのに、意地汚いと罵られ!?
4. 『初恋はざまぁのあとで』　漫画：山野でこ　[原作](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n6482hx/)：志波咲良
婚約破棄をされ、家族からも見放された令嬢が海で出会ったのは——
5. 『婚約破棄？「喜んで！」食い気味に答えたら陛下に泣きつかれたけど、知らんがな』　漫画：とかい なか　[原作](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n4904hv/)：みねバイヤーン
念願の婚約破棄に喜ぶ令嬢は王都を離れて暮らすことにしたが——？
6. 『婚約破棄前日に戻ってきました』　漫画：ARATA　[原作](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n8456hl/)：ロゼ
王家と強引に婚約させられた挙句、無実の罪で断罪された令嬢は生き延びるために——？
+++
+++**第6巻の内容：**
1. 『お化け令嬢の結婚～幸せなメイク、ここにあります～』　漫画：今波マナ
「化け物」と呼ばれ社交界から去った令嬢が メイクをきっかけに出会ったのは——。
2. 『婚約破棄されて、そのまま新しい婚約者と既成事実を作らされる為に軟禁されました。』　漫画：古川スネ　[原作 (R18)](https://novel18.syosetu.com/n0917hw/)：直江あき
婚約破棄されすぐに、新たな婚約を結ばれたのは 憧れの騎士様——!?
3. 『目立ちたくない悪役令嬢の華麗なる奮闘～攻略対象の王弟の地味化をお手伝いします！～』　漫画：弘青
見目麗しい王弟からの依頼は、地味になる秘訣を伝授すること——!?
4. 『それでもいい、貴方と共にあるのなら』　漫画：春木メジロー　[原作](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n2872hr/)：牧場のばら
婚約者を妹にとられてしまった令嬢は 旧友である殿下と——？
5. 『駆け落ち予定という妹の脅しで、婚約者を交換しました。代わりに呪われ公爵さまのお飾りの妻になりましたが、推しのお世話係は完全にご褒美です』　漫画：南野のこ　[原作](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n5292if/)：石河翠
新たな婚約者はまさかの「推し」。けれど嫁ぎ先に「推し」の姿はなく——。
6. 『捨てられた「完璧令嬢」はグレることに致しました！』　漫画：オオトリ　[原作](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n2809hy/)：深見アキ
婚約破棄されてグレた令嬢が 男装をはじめてみたら——？
+++
+++**第7巻の内容：**
1. 『婚約破棄され国王殺しの罪を着せられそうになった私を救ったのは王宮医師団の青年でした』　漫画：橘ひより　[原作](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n0592id/)：銀野きりん
第一王子から婚約破棄を言い渡された私。あろうことか、毒殺の疑いをかけられて――!?
2. 『初対面で大変丁寧に婚約破棄を言い渡されましたが、話し合いの結果お友達から始めることになりました。』　漫画：和サン　[原作](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n4497hu/)：新星緒
領地からわざわざ出向いたのに婚約破棄!? もっと早くに言ってください！
3. 『婚約破棄にて奴隷生活から解放されたので、もう貴方の面倒は見ませんよ？』　漫画：杜タカノ　[原作](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n4659ii/)：かのん
婚約破棄された令嬢が流すのは、奴隷扱いから解放された嬉し涙…!?
4. 『今更戻れと言われても、醜いカエルの追放聖女の私がやっと元の姿になれたので、もう二度と戻りません。』　漫画：春乃まい　[原作](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n4235hx/)：大野ちた
醜いと言われ婚約破棄&追放された聖女は隣国で力を発揮し――？
5. 『ワガママ王女の婚約について』　漫画：松浦ぶんこ　[原作](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n3842dk/)：しきみ彰
私の前でだけ笑わない婚約者。彼の幸せを思い婚約解消を告げたら…？
+++
+++**第8巻の内容：**
1. 『無敵のシスコン三兄弟は、断罪を力技で回避する。』　漫画：かしい葵　[原作](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n8828ij/)：櫻野くるみ
侯爵家唯一の娘は地味な見た目でも、優秀な三兄弟に溺愛されてます――!?
2. 『実は白い結婚でしたの。元悪役令嬢は未亡人になったので今度こそ推しを見守りたい。』　漫画：ののせりん　[原作](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n7472hx/)：氷雨そら
婚約破棄され辺境伯に嫁ぎ、辺境伯の亡き後、推しを眺めるため王都へ来たけれど…？
3. 『「男を愛してしまった」と言って婚約破棄されましたが、それって男装した私ですか！？』　漫画：橘ミズキ　原作：田井ノエル
大好きな王子が密かに憧れているのは 男装して兄の代わりに騎士団長として活躍する私――!?
4. 『婚約破棄された男前女騎士を私（※男）が完璧な淑女にしてみせるわ！』　漫画：白松　原作：風見まつり
貴族相談役を請け負っている伯爵は、隣国の騎士令嬢から 「女らしさ」を教えてほしいと言われ――!?
5. 『婚約破棄された公爵令嬢は、星の光に導かれて』　漫画：如月芳規　[原作](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n2630if/)：彩戸ゆめ
婚約破棄された公爵令嬢は、自身を守るため 冒険者とともに隣国へと向かうが…。
+++
+++**第9巻の内容：**
1. 『あざとすぎると婚約破棄されましたが計算どおりです』　漫画：みまさか　原作：冬月光輝
姉から奪った婚約者が私の本性を知って、あざとい悪女めと再び破談を申し入れ――!?
2. 『研究に専念したいのでお断りしたら幸せになっちゃいました』　漫画：あおいさり　キャラクター原案：おの秋人
魔道具研究に没頭しすぎだと婚約破棄された！――あら、更に研究に打ち込めるのでは？
3. 『婚約破棄を申し込まれましたが、そのお話こそ破棄させていただきたく！』　漫画：冨月一乃　原作：星彼方
愛する婚約者から婚約破棄状を送られた令嬢は 納得できずに彼のもとへ向かうが――!?
4. 『不遇な青い鳥が幸せになるまで』　漫画：春乃まい　原作：編乃肌
「幸せを運ぶ」と言われている青い羽を持つ令嬢。その力を発揮できず、婚約者に捨てられて――。
5. 『私のことが大嫌いなはずの王子殿下が、溺愛恋人扱いをしてくれる。』　漫画：たかのかな　原作：雨川透子
婚約破棄され、研究院の在籍資格はく奪の危機に、学生時代からのライバルに偽装婚約を提案され――!?
+++

description.en:
Kurogane Hiroto is in high school, where he is academically the top of his class but literally the worst in physical activity. Born with a weak body, he has no endurance, speed nor strength and Hiroto wants nothing more than to be a hero. Fate teases him by giving him phenomenal eye sight, which allows him to see well beyond anyone else in sports, but his body is not able to react to any of it.  
  
He learns from his friend Shiratori, who wants to recruit him for the Kendo team, about a rumor about a ghost named Tojo Sayuri, who wields a katana and haunts an alley in the city. Half curious, Hiroto goes there only to find that the ghost is real and that Tojo Sayuri has been looking for a successor to her Sakura sword style for 150 years. Sayuri chooses him as the successor after being able to dodge her attack and forces him to learn the Sakura style. Even with the help of the ancient swordsman ghost, Hiroto has to overcome his poor motor skills in order to be the hero he always wanted to be.

Growth cheats? Infinite magic power? The ability to utilize all archetypes? What’s the point if instant death ends everything with a single attack?

Awaking to absolute chaos and carnage while on a school trip, Yogiri Takatou discovers that everyone in his class has been transported to another world!

He had somehow managed to sleep through the entire ordeal himself, missing out on the Gift — powers bestowed upon the others by a mysterious Sage who appeared to transport them. Even worse, he and another classmate were ruthlessly abandoned by their friends, left as bait to distract a nearby dragon. Although not terribly bothered by the thought of dying, he reluctantly decides to protect his lone companion. After all, a lowly Level 1000 monster doesn't stand a chance against his secret power to invoke Instant Death with a single thought!

If he can stay awake long enough to bother using it, that is...
description.id:
**Pertumbuhan cheat? Kekuatan sihir tak terbatas? Kemampuan untuk menggunakan semua arketipe? Apa gunanya semua itu jika kematian instan mengakhiri segalanya dengan satu serangan?** 

Saat terbangun dalam kekacauan dan pembantaian saat perjalanan sekolah, Yogiri Takatou menemukan bahwa semua teman sekelasnya telah dipindahkan ke dunia lain! Dia entah bagaimana berhasil tidur selama seluruh kejadian itu, melewatkan pemberian — kekuatan yang diberikan kepada orang lain oleh seorang Sage misterius yang muncul untuk memindahkan mereka. Yang lebih buruk, dia dan seorang teman sekelas lainnya ditinggalkan dengan kejam oleh teman-teman mereka, dijadikan umpan untuk mengalihkan perhatian seekor naga yang sedang mendekat. 

Meskipun tidak terlalu terganggu oleh pemikiran tentang kematian, dia dengan enggan memutuskan untuk melindungi satu-satunya temannya. Lagipula, monster Level 1000 yang rendah tidak ada artinya melawan kekuatan rahasianya untuk memanggil Kematian Instan dengan satu pikiran! 

Jika dia bisa tetap terjaga cukup lama untuk menggunakan kekuatannya itu, tentu saja...

description.en:
A terrible creature has been plaguing the community: a man with a fishbowl for a head. When he attacks someone, the goldfish leaps out of his bowl and drinks their blood. The victim is irreversibly transformed into a goldfish! This terrible crime has happened to high-schooler Kousuke's little sister. With no other option, he takes care of his goldfish-sister as best he can.  
  
One day, he comes across a strange girl named Ringo, who wears a school swimsuit, carries an umbrella, and keeps a gun hanging around her neck. Ringo is an apprentice blood diver, and the gun is her way of shooting herself into the wounds of the fishbowl man's victims. If she can get to them in time, she can prevent them from turning into goldfish. Ringo's mentor, Ichigo, says that she's heard of a way to turn people back from goldfish into humans. Kousuke is determined to help Ringo find a way to help his sister and the loved ones of his friends at school who have met the same fishy fate!

Um dia, ele encontra uma garota estranha chamada Ringo, que veste um maiô escolar, carrega um guarda-chuva e mantém uma arma pendurada no pescoço. Ringo é um aprendiz de mergulhador de sangue, e a arma é sua maneira de atirar nas feridas das vítimas do homem do aquário. Se ela conseguir alcançá-los a tempo, poderá impedir que se transformem em peixinhos dourados.  O mentor de Ringo, Ichigo, diz que ouviu falar de uma maneira de transformar as pessoas de peixinhos dourados em humanos. In a village affected by rural depopulation, a grower named Keita creates a new fig species that gets recommended by a web celebrity. The local economy starts to pick up thanks to media exposure, which gives Keita hope for the local school to reopen, in order to convince his wife to come back with their daughter.

Sōichirō Yamamoto (山本 崇一朗, Yamamoto Sōichirō, born May 31, 1986) is a Japanese manga artist. He is known for writing and illustrating [Teasing Master Takagi-san](https://mangadex.org/title/6e445564-d9a8-4862-bff1-f4d6be6dba2c/karakai-jouzu-no-takagi-san), [Fudatsuki no Kyōko-chan](https://mangadex.org/title/3ac9fd03-e3de-4520-90aa-d9fc002eac0a/fudatsuki-no-kyoko-chan), [In the Heart of Kunoichi Tsubaki](https://mangadex.org/title/1ab5f7e0-7768-457c-9f63-19471b6503cc/kunoichi-tsubaki-no-mune-no-uchi), and [When Will Ayumu Make His Move?](https://mangadex.org/title/425f2ccf-581f-42cf-aed3-c3312fcde926/soredemo-ayumu-wa-yosetekuru), all of which were ran simultaneously during their publication. 

Yamamoto was born and raised in the town of Tonoshō in Shōdoshima, an island part of Kagawa Prefecture. His hometown would later serve as the setting for Teasing Master Takagi-san.

He is a graduate of Kyoto Seika University Faculty of Art. 

(Source: [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/S%C5%8Dichir%C5%8D_Yamamoto))

Ten years ago, a black shape appeared in the sky and destroyed the city below. Kagerou and Momiji were children when the destruction took place, and they have grown together into teenagers beneath the mysterious structure. There is an undeniable attraction between these two friends, but Kagerou is hesitant to confess his feelings because he feels that he is too weak to protect her.   
  
One day, the structure acts again, sending down strange balls that eat people and transform them into monsters. Kagerou and Momiji's encounter that day changes them forever. Kagerou is taken into an organization that explains to him that he is now an "ember," and Momiji is a non-human "dross," useful only as experimental material. Kagerou can't accept this, though, and is determined to do anything in his power to protect the girl he loves.

description.en: Yataro Araki, a member of the Tojo High School soccer team, has big dreams. Within a decade, he sees himself conquering the soccer world’s loftiest peak: European “football!” Fast forward to what may be his last soccer match before graduation, the match that will make or break his dreams. Having thus far failed to attract the attention of scouts, he is now desperate to do whatever it takes to prove himself. Yataro is prepared to get his hands dirty if it means winning. If it means standing at the top! Welcome to the world of international football! Nothing is sacred, no rule is left unbroken! Not when victory is on the line!
description.fr: Yataro Araki, membre de l’équipe de football du lycée Tōjō, nourrit de grandes ambitions : dans dix ans, il se voit déjà au sommet du football européen. Mais alors qu’il dispute peut-être son tout dernier match avant la fin du lycée, tout est en jeu. Jusqu’ici ignoré par les recruteurs, il n’a plus le choix : il doit se faire remarquer, coûte que coûte. Quitte à franchir les limites, à salir ses mains, s’il le faut. Car pour atteindre le sommet, tous les moyens sont bons. Bienvenue dans l’univers impitoyable du football international, où aucune règle n’est sacrée et où seule la victoire compte !

Thời gian trôi qua, vào trận cuối cùng trước khi tốt nghiệp, và cũng là trận sẽ quyết định giấc mơ của cậu. Mọi thứ sẽ vô nghĩa nếu Araki không được tuyển trạch viên nào để ý đến, vì vậy cậu sẵn lòng làm tất cả mọi thứ, kể cả khi phải chơi bẩn để giành lấy chiến thắng. Nếu nó giúp cậu vươn đến đỉnh cao! Chào mừng đến với giới bóng đá quốc tế! Không tồn tại thứ gọi là bất khả xâm phạm hay luật lệ! Ít nhất là khi chiến thắng đang cận kề!
